items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Wayne King used to play at that time.

ctx.x: No, not on the board. That's why I made headlines with all them papers. Started to, you know, start putting my name in the papers. Brother of my dreams, I love you. I mean all them numbers was out. Brother of my dreams and all them waltzes and all that stuff like Wayne King used to play at that time. And you made headlines? I mean all the papers all up and down them rivers, you understand? The boat, like you say, couldn't hardly hold the people, you understand what I mean? And there used to be some ruffians on…
Well they were pretty rough around that and waterproof, huh? People got drowned out.
